text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementGeneralWas Einstein Seduced by a Russian Honeypot Operation?The physicist had a steamy romance with Margarita KonenkovaJCBy Jake Currie1:06 PM CST on November 12, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleNvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down today just days after he admitted to having an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. The relationship raised alarms at United States intelligence agencies, who reportedly believed his paramour, Alice Huang (no relation), was passing secrets to the Chinese government in addition to encouraging the CEO to lobby for Chinese access to cutting-edge AI chips. Earlier this year, Jensen Huang persuaded President Trump to allow Nvidia to resume selling the chips to China, in exchange for the U.S. government taking a 25-percent cut on all sales.  Powered By 1011.7K 10ShareNextStayIt may very well be the most successful honeypot operation in history, but it’s not the only attempt to seduce state secrets from a prominent official. In fact, Albert Einstein had his own romance with an alleged Soviet spy named Margarita Konenkova, who was reportedly after inside information on the Manhattan Project.  Read more: “The Catch 22 of Hacktivism”Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
